title: Jacoby Brissett, Josh Sweat at Cardinals' minicamp but not practicing

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jacoby Brissett, Josh Sweat at Cardinals' minicamp but not practicing
sources.description: Quarterback Jacoby Brissett and edge rusher Josh Sweat are at the Cardinals' mandatory minicamp, avoiding the $107,911 fine it would have cost them for missing all three days.
